name: owner_jj_fair_nyam_25_38

source.title: JJ Simon, The Strategy Behind My $1.6M in Prop Firm Payouts (+ Chart Fanatics interview KHEQ5g55dQ4)

entry.words: Fair price is the 9:30 open. After the first 5 minutes I'm only looking for reversion back to fair price for the following 85 minutes. Entry is a displacement candle: the body of the candle is larger than the body of the previous candle and it closes below the wick (it has to displace a candle of the opposite colour). I need at least 30 points in my favor to take the 25/38. No max number of trades. If I lose three in a row, I'm done.

[KN7j6NXXAio 2:33] fair price is 95% of the time the market open (the pre-open price)
[KN7j6NXXAio 5:36] 25-point stop loss and 38-point take profit, 1 to 1.5, for every trade (evaluations)
[KHEQ5g55dQ4 5:04, 54:39] displacement: two qualifications, the body must be larger and it must close below (beyond) the wick
[KHEQ5g55dQ4 69:05] a displacement has to displace a candle of the opposite colour
[BLvsYJ4sqn8 3:36] I wouldn't take anything if it's not 30 points away (30 points of room for a 38-point target; the 80% rule)

not_run: THE 09:30 CONTINUATION (opening candle colour, 25/38 or 50/76 when its body is over 25 points): not in this sheet; a sheet of its own.
BREAK-OF-STRUCTURE ENTRIES (his A+ setup, funded accounts): not run; displacement only (his evaluation entry).
MOVING THE FAIR LINE (a break of structure away and a new consolidation; unexpected news): by eye, not run: fair is always the 09:30 open.
08:30 EXPECTED NEWS DAYS (the pre-news price as fair): not run: the 09:30 open is used on every day.
BREAKEVEN when the opening push stalls, TWO CANDLES COMBINED as one displacement, mid-candle and limit entries: by eye, not run.
ACCOUNTS: one account takes every trade here (one position at a time); his layering / rotation over many accounts is the prop step, not this ledger.
MY PICKS: side and the 30-point room read on the displacement candle's close; entry = market at that close; a trade's result counts toward the 3 in a row when it closes (net < 0 after costs).
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
